proof: rtl_string_new binds the concrete static empty byte owner before the try. The actual checked converter leaves that owner unchanged on checked failure; on success it assigns a non-null allocated owner or the same concrete empty owner. Allocation-null paths throw before normal return. No target-slot reference escapes to external callbacks. Thus normal return cannot leave null. Genuine original replaceable-allocator failure for UTF8 NUL executes the nullable finally alternative and propagates its assertion; it is covered, not excluded.
